decisions.reason: Having survived the first review and staying close to the core assortment, this carpet remains a low-cost option worth keeping while demand continues to reveal itself.
The premium hand-knotted carpet still supports the firm's design-led positioning and is likely inexpensive to keep on offer relative to the option value of niche high-end sales.
Its overlap with other carpets keeps some withdrawal risk alive, but after being retained while another carpet was removed it still looks worthwhile to keep as a close-to-core option.
The corner bench is more use-specific and likely costlier to carry than the carpets, yet it builds on established capabilities and has not shown enough to justify abandonment now.
